title: Operator lands the marked acceptance for gvc, xte, wne and the gvc evidence binding
body: klq's machinery is committed, but its own acceptance ('xte, wne and gvc carry marked acceptance') needs tracker writes (.tick/issues/*.json via tk) that this worker's boundary forbids, so the marking and the A6 = "go" binding in .tick/runners.toml are not landed. The RESULT-klq.md report carries verbatim, parser-verified marked acceptance texts (gvc A1-A9, xte A10-A14, wne A15-A20), the [evidence.acceptance] block, and the repoconfig guard-test posture flip to land together. pzp, bse, nfo and npq are all blocked on this landing.
